data.name: Scrying Adept
data.description: You are always aware when you are being observed via magic, as if you had a permanent Detect Scrying. In addition, whenever you scry on a subject, treat the subject as one step more familiar to you. Very familiar subjects get a -10 penalty on their save to avoid your scrying attempts.
